<aside class="blog-tldr not-prose"><div class="blog-tldr__label">TL;DR</div><div class="blog-tldr__body">
- TEAM is not optional
- 2026 upside-only is temporary
- Post-acute spend still counts
- Track choice has real stakes
</div></aside>

Dr. Rob Bart serves as Chief Medical Information Officer at UPMC and is a member of Rainfall Health’s R.A.I.N. Advisory Committee. His career — spanning CMIO roles at UPMC and the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services, plus a prior role as chief medical officer for pediatrics at Cerner — informs the informatics lens applied to these myths.

## Myth 1: "TEAM is optional."

**Reality:** It is mandatory for IPPS hospitals whose CCN sits in one of the 188 selected Core-Based Statistical Areas (CBSAs). There is no opt-out.

## Myth 2: "There’s no risk in 2026, so we can wait."

**Reality:** While Performance Year 1 is upside-only, two-sided risk begins in 2027, and target prices already reflect a 1.5–2% discount from day one. From Dr. Bart’s informatics vantage point, the deeper risk is timeline: the multi-source data infrastructure TEAM demands takes many months to build.

## Myth 3: "TEAM only affects orthopedics."

**Reality:** It covers five procedures including CABG, spinal fusion and major bowel — cardiac and general surgery service lines are equally exposed.

## Myth 4: "Cost is what matters; quality is secondary."

**Reality:** The Composite Quality Score adjusts reconciliation by up to 10% (positive) or 15% (negative) and can flip a projected savings into a repayment.

## Myth 5: "Our existing analytics are enough."

**Reality:** TEAM spans multiple care settings with claims lagging six months; retrospective reporting cannot support the real-time intervention the model rewards.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is participation in CMS TEAM optional?

No. Participation is mandatory for IPPS hospitals in one of the 188 selected CBSAs.

### Does quality really affect CMS TEAM payment?

Yes. The Composite Quality Score can adjust reconciliation by up to 10% positive or 15% negative, which can flip a projected savings into a repayment.

### Does CMS TEAM only affect orthopedic service lines?

No. TEAM covers five procedures across orthopedics, cardiac surgery (CABG), spinal fusion, and general surgery (major bowel procedures).

### When does financial risk start under CMS TEAM?

Two-sided financial risk begins in Performance Year 2, which is 2027.
